spiritgiven.comments: Very spirited team and very fair-minded game!
It felt like there was a mismatch between the contact our opponents were willing to receive and the contact our opponents were initiating.
Some dangerous plays. Many players not knowing the rules. Almost every contact call was not followed and we had to call violation.
We appreciated that calls were resolved quickly and that body contact was improved by both teams throughout the game.
We had great communication both during and in between points, and we appreciated the effort from both teams to hold each other accountable to the rules.

We appreciate the conversation about our body contact and apologize that we didn’t engage with you in a way that felt respectful. We felt your body contact on the mark created a lot of contact and did not adjust after multiple contact and foul calls. We have a lot of respect for you all as opponents and felt that mostly the game was highly spirited and well fought.

spiritreceived.comments:
Great game - great communication on calls, re-positioning after calls, fouls, resolution… all around great! Thank you thank you all !! And we hope your injured player will be ok and able to play the rest of the competition. Cheers ! 
Xoxo, 
France
Such a nice game! We loved your vibes and how you listened to us during the calls!
Both teams had great energy, and despite the intensity of the plays, the spirit was positive throughout the game. Thank you for your patience(in terms of language difficulties) and respect!

Good rules and knowledge 
Thank you for cleaning up the contact after half

A couple of players felt constant contact even though we gave constant feedback of this, feeling like this was the way they wanted to play against us. There was one dangerous play that ended on a crash with our player on the end zone. We encourage that the use of legs during stall counts maintains the same line of the body as one of our players got kicked in the hand when trying to get a foot block
Certain players straddle their defender and make it so that no matter how we move in offense we cause contact. This got a bit better in the second half but was still happening
Coach on the sideline was saying some derogatory things about our team. Thank you to the players for being well spirited and respectful
